answer: Agents perform 1,000 unique computational units as the scarce resource for enrollment, where honest nodes pay once while 1,000 fakes incur 1,000 times the effort to scale. A verifier challenges agents via an ivory gate to provide proof of task completion. If the system detects memory leakage matching a sparrow in the horizon of parallel outputs, it burns the identity and forfeits all deposits to prevent cloning.
